reviews.title: 銳評
reviews.text:
您好，我想針對 WePlay 目前的遊戲環境、管理制度及玩家體驗提出一些建議。

我觀察到不少玩家對 WePlay 有以下幾項不滿，希望官方能夠正視：

一、客服及申訴制度

1. 客服處理效率有待提升，部分問題長時間得不到有效答覆。
2. 部分客服回覆過於制式化，沒有針對玩家實際問題提出解決方案。
3. 玩家遭到停權時，希望官方能提供具體違規原因及相關說明。
4. 希望建立更完善的申訴制度，避免玩家因誤判或惡意檢舉而受到不合理處分。

二、遊戲環境及管理

1. 遊戲內仍有辱罵、挑釁、騷擾及其他不良行為。
2. 希望加強違規玩家的管理，而不是單純依靠玩家自行檢舉。
3. 希望改善惡意檢舉問題，避免正常玩家受到不公平的處分。
4. 希望提高檢舉處理效率，讓玩家能夠真正感受到平台有在維護遊戲環境。

三、遊戲經濟及消費制度

1. 部分服裝、戒指及虛擬商品價格偏高。
2. 免費玩家取得遊戲資源的難度較高。
3. 希望增加合理的免費獎勵管道，讓不儲值的玩家也能享有完整的遊戲體驗。
4. 希望改善抽獎機制及獎勵取得方式，提高玩家參與活動的意願。

四、遊戲品質及系統

1. 部分遊戲存在判定不準確、操作失靈等問題。
2. 部分遊戲配對時間過長，影響遊戲體驗。
3. 希望改善遊戲效能、耗電量及容量問題。
4. 希望官方在推出新功能及新遊戲的同時，也能持續維護原有功能。
5.遊戲幾乎都是抄襲，希望官方自己能有點主見
最後，我想強調：

WePlay 是一個以社交及娛樂為核心的平台，玩家留下來不應該只是因為已經投入了時間或金錢，而是因為真正喜歡這個平台。

希望官方不要只重視新活動、新商品及營收，也能夠重視既有玩家的使用體驗、消費權益及遊戲環境。

如果玩家提出問題後，得到的始終只是制式化回覆，那麼玩家的意見又有什麼意義？

希望官方能夠將以上問題列入實際改善計畫，而不只是收集意見。

謝謝。

reviews.title: Please Remove Voice Room from Mic Grab
reviews.text:
Hi WePlay, I’d like to give some feedback about the Voice Room version of Mic Grab.

Since the Voice Room was introduced, there seem to be fewer and fewer players in the Normal Mode. Because of this, it now takes a long time for a game to start since there aren’t enough players.

At the same time, the Voice Room version doesn’t seem to solve the problem either. Once the game starts, some players suddenly leave, and sometimes you end up playing alone. It’s really frustrating and takes away the fun of the game.

I hope you can consider removing the Voice Room version from Mic Grab, or at least find a way to bring more players back to the Normal Mode. The Normal Mode used to have more active players and games started much faster.

Please consider this feedback because the current situation is making Mic Grab less enjoyable to play. Thank you!

It is constantly getting worse and becoming annoying which can indefinitely result in the players/users of the WePlay application being bored and quitting the game altogether. Too much updates does not result from device crashing but rather the game itself, Codm is a high resolution high performance game that require good processing devices, yet it does not face the same problems as the WePlay application. 

This Application’s fall is increasingly becoming true, users are now quitting the usage of the game due to the factor of its performance issues.

The latest update has left many players feeling that progression and rewards now require more financial investment, while offering less value than in earlier versions. What used to feel like meaningful progress through time and effort can now feel harder to achieve, and for some, a bit discouraging.

Overall, feedback remains mixed, but there is a growing emotional concern about whether the balance between monetization and player enjoyment still feels fair and satisfying.

reviews.title: 6.9.0 Version
reviews.text:
We, the players and members of the WePlay community, respectfully raise our concerns regarding the recent Version 6.9.0 update. While we understand that updates are necessary to improve the application and create new opportunities, we feel that the current direction of the game has significantly affected what made WePlay enjoyable in the first place.

The increasing pay-to-win elements have taken away much of the excitement and motivation to play. Games should allow players to enjoy themselves, build friendships, compete fairly, and create memorable experiences regardless of how much money they spend. Unfortunately, many players now feel that spending has become more important than skill, participation, teamwork, and genuine enjoyment.

WePlay has always been more than just an application. For many of us, it has been a place where friendships were formed, communities were built, families and groups came together, and players enjoyed competing and spending time with one another. Camaraderie should not become secondary to monetization. When players feel that they cannot compete or enjoy the game without continuously spending, the sense of community that keeps people engaged begins to disappear.

reviews.text: 日前我收到系統通知，得知我的帳號遭到「永久封鎖」，並且連帶限制了我的設備功能。對於此項處分結果，我深感遺憾，且完全無法接受如此極端的限制。我理解並尊重平台維護社區環境的職責，若我的帳號確實有違反社群規範之處，平台依照規定給予懲罰（如：封鎖帳號 1 年或 2 年），讓玩家承擔相應的責任，我認為這是合情合理的。然而，平台在未提供明確、具體且無可爭辯的違規證據下，直接採取「永久封鎖」並「限制整台設備無法遊玩」的最高處分，這已嚴重剝奪了我未來使用該遊戲的權利，完全不符合行政處分的「比例原則」。我的訴求如下：提供具體違規事證： 請客服詳細說明並提供我具體在何時、何地、做出了哪一項嚴重違反法規的行為，而非僅用罐頭訊息帶過。重新評估處分強度： 我請求平台重新審查，將「永久封鎖帳號及設備」變更為「定期限的停權處分（如 1-2 年）」。直接剝奪玩家終身使用權且鎖定設備，處分過於嚴苛且不合理。我對本遊戲投入了大量的心血與時間，希望平台能正視玩家的權益，給予合理的說明與更有彈性的處理方式。若平台仍堅持無證據的永久封鎖，我將不排除向消保單位提起申訴以維護權益。期待您的積極回覆。祝 順心

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
Your platform claims to have a violation handling system, but it appears to be ineffective. Many users continue to violate the community guidelines, and despite submitting reports, no visible action is taken against them.
This creates the impression that the reporting system is not being properly enforced. I have reported multiple violations, yet the same users remain active without consequences.
I do not recommend this platform because of the lack of effective moderation and enforcement of its own policies. There are too many issues that need to be addressed, especially regarding user safety and community standards.

reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text:
Very unfair experience. I have been playing this game for almost 3 years and have spent money on top-ups, but my account was banned for 12 hours without a proper investigation.
A user I met in a voice room reported me after a conversation that was meant as a joke. The next day, I received a warning and was shocked by the action taken against my account. The player who reported me was the one who started the argument, yet no proper review of the full situation was done before taking action against me. This is my first getting banned for almost 3 years, imagine that.

I hope WePlay improves its review process and investigates reports fairly before taking action against long-time players.

reviews.title: 2 years experience in WePlay
reviews.text:
This is my honest review for the past 2years that I've played. This is the game where I found my happiness for the first year, but this is also the game that interfered my real life for the past year. It took a while before they got to fix the security of every player. Altho the admins were very helpful and do care in the end, it was already too late for them to fix the damages this game has caused me. This game could gain you friends and bring them to real life, but the vast community made it feel so unease whenever you recharge. Tons of judgments and bullying which the admins can't handle. I hope WePlay would be able to strengthen the security and safety of the players
